title: The Clock of Valparaíso
author: Rafael Kavanagh
blurb: Xanthe Reyes, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
